name: useComputedTheme
description: A hook that returns the fully resolved v11.7+ theme object from the context.

returns.description:
An object containing the computed `primitives`, `semantics`,
`components` and `sharedTokens` of the current theme.
returns.type: { primitives: any; semantics: Record<string, unknown>; components: Record<string, unknown>; sharedTokens: Record<string, unknown>; }
